sources.scope_note: Temporary emergency demand aggregation and joint purchasing regime, prolonged only through 31 December 2024.

targets.scope_note: Permanent demand aggregation and joint purchasing mechanism under Section 5 of Regulation 2024/1789.

source_refs.locator: Recital 111: crisis measures transformed into permanent features; expressly includes demand aggregation and joint purchasing and explains timing to avoid overlap.
Recitals 24-25 and Article 1(3): temporary prolongation through 31 December 2024.

notes: Genealogy only. The edge does not imply that the AggregateEU brand, service-provider contract, IT platform, or every operational feature remained identical across the legal-basis transition.
